question: How many ordered pairs of non-internal junctions become unreachable when junction H5 is removed from the road network? A pair (A, B) 'becomes unreachable' if a directed path from A to B existed in the original network (paths may pass through H5) but no directed path exists after removing junction H5 and every edge that starts or ends at H5. Exclude internal junctions (IDs starting with ':'). Do NOT count pairs where A or B is H5 itself. Answer format: <integer>
